svg.title: Мобилизация запястий — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Wrist mobility on hands and knees. True side oblique view. BOTH palms flat under shoulders, fingers point forward, knees down, elbows straight. LEFT forearms vertical with shoulders directly over wrists. RIGHT body rocks gently forward, shoulders clearly ahead of wrists, hands and knees stay exactly fixed, palms and fingers still flat. Show wrist angle change without adding equipment. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
